UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores profile information for users of the HelmLogic application, excluding sensitive authentication details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

organization.description: The organization or company the user belongs to.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Vessel.title: Vessel
Vessel.description: Represents a maritime vessel managed within the HelmLogic system, including its specifications and identifying information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vessel entity.

name.description: The common name of the vessel.

mmsi.description: Maritime Mobile Service Identity (MMSI) number, a unique nine-digit code for vessels.

imo.description: International Maritime Organization (IMO) number, a unique seven-digit identification number for ships.

vesselType.description: The type of vessel (e.g., 'Cargo Ship', 'Tanker', 'Passenger Ship').

lengthMeters.description: The overall length of the vessel in meters.

widthMeters.description: The overall width (beam) of the vessel in meters.

draughtMeters.description: The draught of the vessel in meters (vertical distance between the waterline and the bottom of the hull).

maxSpeedKnots.description: The maximum service speed of the vessel in knots.

ownerId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who owns or manages this vessel. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Vessel)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the vessel record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the vessel record was last updated.

Route.title: Route
Route.description: Defines a planned or optimized maritime route for a specific vessel, including its start, end, and overall characteristics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Route entity.

name.description: A descriptive name for the route (e.g., 'Rotterdam to New York').

vesselId.description: Reference to the Vessel this route is planned for. (Relationship: Vessel 1:N Route)

originPort.description: The starting port or location of the route.

destinationPort.description: The destination port or location of the route.

estimatedStartTime.description: The estimated departure time for the route.

estimatedArrivalTime.description: The estimated arrival time at the destination for the route.

distanceNauticalMiles.description: The total estimated distance of the route in nautical miles.

estimatedDurationHours.description: The total estimated duration of the route in hours.

status.description: The current status of the route (e.g., 'Planned', 'InProgress', 'Completed', 'Optimized', 'Cancelled').

optimizedByAiRecordId.description: Optional reference to the RouteOptimizationRecord that generated or last optimized this route. (Relationship: RouteOptimizationRecord 1:1 Route)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the route record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the route record was last updated.

Waypoint.title: Waypoint
Waypoint.description: Represents a specific geographical point along a maritime route, used for navigation and tracking.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Waypoint entity.

routeId.description: Reference to the Route this waypoint belongs to. (Relationship: Route 1:N Waypoint)

latitude.description: The latitude of the waypoint in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: The longitude of the waypoint in decimal degrees.

sequenceOrder.description: The sequential order of this waypoint within its route, starting from 1.

eta.description: Estimated Time of Arrival at this specific waypoint.

description.description: An optional description or note for the waypoint (e.g., 'Pass through Strait of Gibraltar').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the waypoint record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the waypoint record was last updated.

VesselLocationUpdate.title: VesselLocationUpdate
VesselLocationUpdate.description: Records a real-time or historical location and status update for a specific vessel.

id.description: Unique identifier for the VesselLocationUpdate entity.

vesselId.description: Reference to the Vessel for which this location update is recorded. (Relationship: Vessel 1:N VesselLocationUpdate)

timestamp.description: The precise date and time of the location update.

latitude.description: The latitude of the vessel's position in decimal degrees at the time of the update.

longitude.description: The longitude of the vessel's position in decimal degrees at the time of the update.

speedKnots.description: The speed of the vessel in knots at the time of the update.

headingDegrees.description: The true heading of the vessel in degrees (0-359) at the time of the update.

status.description: The operational status of the vessel at the time of the update (e.g., 'Underway', 'Moored', 'AtAnchor', 'Stopped').

currentRouteId.description: Optional reference to the Route the vessel is currently following. (Relationship: Route 1:N VesselLocationUpdate)

RouteOptimizationRecord.title: RouteOptimizationRecord
RouteOptimizationRecord.description: Stores the details, parameters, and results of a generative AI-powered route optimization request.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RouteOptimizationRecord entity.

requesterId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who initiated the route optimization request. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N RouteOptimizationRecord)

vesselId.description: Reference to the Vessel for which the route was optimized. (Relationship: Vessel 1:N RouteOptimizationRecord)

requestTimestamp.description: The date and time when the optimization request was made.

originPort.description: The specified origin port for the optimization.

destinationPort.description: The specified destination port for the optimization.

requestedDepartureTime.description: The user-requested departure time used as a parameter for optimization.

factorsConsidered.description: A list of factors the AI considered during optimization (e.g., 'weather', 'traffic', 'regulations', 'vessel_specs').

aiOutputSummary.description: A summary of the AI's findings, recommendations, or key considerations for the optimized route.

recommendedRouteId.description: Reference to the Route entity that was generated or recommended by this optimization process. (Relationship: RouteOptimizationRecord 1:1 Route)

status.description: The status of the optimization request (e.g., 'Pending', 'Completed', 'Failed').

completionTimestamp.description: The date and time when the optimization process was completed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the optimization record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the optimization record was last updated.

definition.description: Stores user profile data. Each document's ID (`userId`) corresponds to the Firebase Authentication UID, which serves as the explicit owner. This collection adheres to path-based ownership for private user data.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

definition.description: Collection of vessels owned by a specific user. Each document includes a denormalized 'ownerId' field that must match the parent 'userId' for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user who owns this vessel.

params.name: vesselId
params.description: The unique identifier for the vessel.

definition.description: Subcollection of routes planned for a specific vessel. Each document includes a denormalized 'ownerId' field, copied from the parent vessel's owner, to ensure authorization independence without requiring 'get()' calls.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user who owns the parent vessel and thus this route.

params.name: vesselId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent vessel.

params.name: routeId
params.description: The unique identifier for the route.

definition.description: Subcollection of waypoints for a specific route. Each document includes a denormalized 'ownerId' field, copied from the grandparent vessel's owner, for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user who owns the associated vessel and route, and thus this waypoint.

params.name: vesselId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent vessel.

params.name: routeId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent route.

params.name: waypointId
params.description: The unique identifier for the waypoint.

definition.description: Subcollection of real-time or historical location updates for a specific vessel. Each document includes a denormalized 'ownerId' field, copied from the parent vessel's owner, for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user who owns the parent vessel and thus this location update.

params.name: vesselId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent vessel.

params.name: updateId
params.description: The unique identifier for the vessel location update.

definition.description: Collection of generative AI-powered route optimization records initiated by a user. Each document's 'requesterId' field must match the parent 'userId' for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user who initiated this optimization request.

params.name: recordId
params.description: The unique identifier for the route optimization record.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to follow a strict hierarchical ownership model, rooted in the user profile. This approach ensures maximal security, clear authorization logic, and efficient data retrieval, adhering to all core design principles.

**Authorization Independence:** This is achieved by systematically denormalizing the `ownerId` (or `requesterId` for `RouteOptimizationRecord`) into every document that is part of a user's owned hierarchy. For example, a `Route` document, residing under `/users/{userId}/vessels/{vesselId}/routes/{routeId}`, will explicitly contain an `ownerId` field. This `ownerId` will be the same `userId` as found in the path itself. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules to check parent documents (e.g., to find the owner of a `Vessel` when accessing a `Route`), thus preventing issues with atomic operations and simplifying rule debugging. All authorization checks can then be performed directly on `request.auth.uid` against the `ownerId` field within the `resource.data` and the `{userId}` wildcard in the path.

**QAPs (Queries as Authorization Postulates):** The structural segregation mandate ensures QAPs are supported. Each collection path represents a homogeneous security posture: all documents within `/users/{userId}/vessels/{vesselId}/routes` are owned by the `{userId}` in the path. This allows for efficient `list` operations, as a user can query their own vessels, routes, waypoints, and optimization records directly. For instance, `db.collection('users').doc(userId).collection('vessels').doc(vesselId).collection('routes').get()` will only return routes owned by that specific user for that specific vessel, and the security rules can enforce this automatically without needing complex filtering logic within the rules themselves. Any query performed within a user's sub-hierarchy is implicitly pre-filtered by ownership. For global read operations, if any were needed, separate top-level collections with appropriate `ownerId` or `members` fields would be used, but are not present here as all data is private and user-owned.
